posts.author: mike_312
posts.body:
Hi, I'd like to know if there's any way to add a window to the RPG Maker MZ battle to view character stats. I have the Visustella plugin, but I don't know if any of them will work.
Thanks.

posts.author: FrigidGaze
posts.body:
Hiya,
A recent update to VS's battle core added 'In-Battle Status Windows' that give a pretty detailed overview of your characters stats and states if that was the kind of thing you were looking for?
Battle Core VisuStella MZ - Yanfly.moe Wiki
www.yanfly.moe
